tagline: Exakta胶片单反相机，1977 年发布
description: Exakta于1977年推出的胶片单反相机。配备simply screw counter clockwise。快门速度Mirror acts like a curtain as a part of the shutter, vertical moving, due to this maximum speed is limited to 1/175; half-depression of the shutter release allows a depth of field preview.。使用special take-up spool, removable。simple matte glass screen,。

specs.快门: Mirror acts like a curtain as a part of the shutter, vertical moving, due to this maximum speed is limited to 1/175; half-depression of the shutter release allows a depth of field preview.
specs.闪光灯: M and X, setting with the speeds knob
specs.英文简介: The Exa 1b is a 35mm film SLR camera, manufactured by VEB Pentacon, former East Germany, and produced between 1977-85.
